title: राधा रानी कृष्ण से रूठती क्यों हैं?
description: राधा रानी श्री कृष्ण से रूठती क्यों हैं? रूठना वहीं होता है जहाँ भरोसा होता है। इसे उसे भेजो जो तुम्हें हमेशा मना लेता है। राधे राधे।

scenes.narration: क्या तुमने कभी सोचा है राधा रानी श्री कृष्ण से रूठती क्यों हैं?
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Wide cinematic shot of Radha, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a long black braid with a small jasmine flower, thin black stick limbs, a saffron-yellow lehenga and a thin red dupatta, sitting alone on the bank of the Yamuna river under a blooming kadamb tree with her face turned away, arms folded, a small pout, while far behind her stands Krishna, a stick character with a smooth soft blue circle head, dot eyes, a small peacock feather on a black crown, thin black stick limbs, a yellow dhoti and a bamboo flute, holding his flute and looking at her gently, soft ripples on the water. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: इसलिए नहीं कि कान्हा उन्हें मना लेते हैं, बल्कि इसलिए क्योंकि राधा रानी जानती हैं कि कृष्ण उन्हें मनाएंगे ही।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Radha, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a long black braid with a small jasmine flower, thin black stick limbs, a saffron-yellow lehenga and a thin red dupatta, standing with her back turned and arms folded under the kadamb tree, a tiny hidden smile on her cheek, while Krishna, a stick character with a smooth soft blue circle head, dot eyes, a small peacock feather on a black crown, thin black stick limbs, a yellow dhoti and a bamboo flute, walks toward her holding out a lotus flower with a tender pose, Vrindavan grove and drifting flower petals around them. Warm golden hour light, soft warm color palette (oranges, earthy tones, muted blues), clean black linework, emotional storytelling aesthetic, detailed background.

scenes.narration: रूठना भी वहीं होता है जहाँ भरोसा होता है।
scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration. Close shot of Radha, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a long black braid with a small jasmine flower, thin black stick limbs, a saffron-yellow lehenga and a thin red dupatta, glancing softly sideways over her shoulder toward Krishna, a stick character with a smooth soft blue circle head, dot eyes, a small peacock feather on a black crown, thin black stick limbs, a yellow dhoti and a bamboo flute, who stands behind her, a small glowing golden heart floating between the two of them, warm light on the river bank. scenes.narration: हर किसी के सामने हम नाराज़गी नहीं दिखाते।

Radha, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a long black braid with a small jasmine flower, thin black stick limbs, a saffron-yellow lehenga and a thin red dupatta, standing calmly among a group of five smiling stick village women at a village ghat with water pots, her face composed and quiet, hurt kept hidden inside, mud houses and a banyan tree in the background. Radha, a stick character with a smooth white circle head, dot eyes, a long black braid with a small jasmine flower, thin black stick limbs, a saffron-yellow lehenga and a thin red dupatta, sitting with a small sulking pout and looking down, while Krishna, a stick character with a smooth soft blue circle head, dot eyes, a small peacock feather on a black crown, thin black stick limbs, a yellow dhoti and a bamboo flute, kneels in front of her with folded hands and a loving smile, a glowing diya on the ground between them, evening Yamuna bank. scenes.image_prompt: A vibrant 2D animated storybook illustration.
